_key.description: Genomic element key and phenotype ontology term joined by an underscore.

z_score.title: Z-Score
z_score.description: Average phenotype z-score across guides targeting the genomic element

log2FC.title: Log2 Fold Change
log2FC.description: FRACTEL element-level estimate on the log2 fold-change scale: the signed directional weighted average of guide-level log2 fold changes with the largest absolute magnitude.

p_value.title: P-Value
p_value.description: P-value for the element's association with the screened phenotype.

neg_log10_pvalue.title: Negative Log10 P-Value
neg_log10_pvalue.description: Negative log 10 p-value of the measurement or prediction

neg_log10_pvalue_adj.title: Negative Log10 Adjusted P-Value
neg_log10_pvalue_adj.description: Negative log 10 FDR-adjusted p-value, capped at 240 for zero p-values.

significant.title: Significant?
significant.description: Whether the FDR-adjusted p-value (when available), otherwise the raw p-value, is below 0.05.

num_guides.title: Number of Guides
num_guides.description: Number of guides targeting the pertubed element in the screen.

num_guides_hit.description: Number of guides that met hit thresholds

num_guides_nonhit.description: Number of guides that did not meet hit thresholds

fraction_guides_hit.title: Fraction of Hit Guides
fraction_guides_hit.description: Fraction of guides that met hit thresholds
